title: Week 1
subtitle: Power Rankings

memo.yearText: Bijan Robinson most rushing yards in the NFL. After week 1 he's 10th with 83. Not great, Nick.
memo.weekText: Dean is picking this week's Dean of the Week. This bar gets updated when he sends it. Also: Shama gets $50 for high score of the week (180).

intro: One week in. Big Sham dropped 180 and collects $50. Dean started two quarterbacks and got negative points. Nick lost by 75, changed his team name, and Bijan is 10th in rushing.
Records and points are real now. Rank is still Tony's opinion. Argue in the chat.

quickHits.text: Big Sham, 180 points, high score of the week, fifty bucks. Josh Allen 42.3, Derrick Henry 35.3, and D'Andre Swift scored 32.4 on his BENCH. He left 27 points sitting there and still won by 61.

quickHits.label: Negative QBs
quickHits.text: Deanus started Kyler Murray (-3.1) and Sam Darnold (0.0). Kyler got knocked out on his 11th snap as a Viking. Darnold didn't play. Two quarterback slots, minus three points, in a league that pays 6 per passing TD. AJ Brown is on IR and Josh Jacobs is on the exempt list. The Tweakers are 0-1 and it's worse than it sounds.

quickHits.label: The Watson curse
quickHits.text: J Will benched Christian Watson. Watson scored 32.7. J Will started Jaylen Waddle at WR for 1.2 and Brock Bowers for 0.0 (inactive, knee). Lost to Tony by 7.2. He would have won with Watson in. The guy Nick drafted by accident is now haunting a different team.

quickHits.label: Shough
quickHits.text: Tyler Shough led the entire NFL in passing yards in week 1 with 410. He is on Nokia Wolson's bench. Nicky started Kyle Pitts at FLEX instead for 0.0 and lost to Reece by 7.6. Shough scored 26.8. Do the math. Or don't, Nicky didn't.

quickHits.label: Lost by 61
quickHits.text: Seeberger scored 119 with the highest projected lineup in the league. Stafford threw for 245 yards and a touchdown and somehow scored 2.9. Jalen Coker had 33.8 on his bench. Named after Waddle, still doesn't own him, and Waddle scored 1.2 anyway so it's fine.

quickHits.label: Fair Weather
quickHits.text: Nfatboy scored 92 points, lost by 75 to the champ, and renamed the team to Fair Weather Fallows. After one game. Bo Nix 4.2, Baker 7.0, Aubrey 2.0. Bijan had 31 of the 92.

quickHits.label: Won ugly
quickHits.text: EN started Ja'Marr Chase (3.2), Colston Loveland (0.0) and Drake Maye (6.7) and won by 19 because he was playing Dean. 101 points. 1-0. The Ball Sniffers way.

quickHits.label: Waiver wire
quickHits.text: Total waiver moves in the league after week 1: one. REEEEECE picked up Kaleb Johnson. That's it. Tony hasn't even made one yet, which is a personal record.

rankings.thoughts: Dean. The midge hit you with the negative points. Both QBs getting hurt in week 1 is truly truly brutal stuff. Might have to get Kaepernick on the phone at this rate. Rob Frank would not be happy about that though. Hey at least this year the Dean of the Year is still alive!
Ass watch. Sorry, but bro thought he could Bolieve and win with this team.
Idk how you won, but you did. The starters on this team are good but the bench is thin. Never play Dowdle and whatever happened to Chase and Loveland this weekend will never happen again. #nostrils

Good team, benching Christian Watson hurts as Jaylen Waddle played like he was "Jay-len on my Waddle". Wouldn't worry as you have the two biggest white boys with the most motion in all of NYC on this team in Skattebo and Dart. You should hit them up to hang out at your crib for team bonding #dartsgfisugly

Think nothing to worry about here. Stafford will never do that again probably, but idk his #back might be hurting him. Even playing Coker would not have got you this dub. Nice profile pic, happy birthday.
That bench though 😉. Solid start to the year, more moves to come and all of that action just to have BC on the bench. Man look tf out. #corrupt #gang

Reece Kenneth Walker Cooke. Big statement in week 1 to come back and beat Nicky. You did all that scoring despite playing 2 Browns players which is wild. Rob Frank is rooting for you because you are #military

media.caption: K9, 173 on the ground, most in the NFL

rankings.thoughts: Mr. Raven himself riding high with his big 180. Congrats on highest scoring and your $50, but you have to admit this happens like every year with the Ravens blowing out a team in the first week. Will see if it holds throughout the year, but you had the chance to score 207 if you just played Swift. #derrickhenryshairisgross
Big Dick! The champ flopped that thang on Nick. He smacked Nick so bad that Carter now calls Daniel his father. Tough times in the Fallows household.

outro: Week 2 rankings drop Tuesday. Dean, send the Dean of the Week.
